name: Elk Grove Youth Commission
what_you_do: Advise the City Council on youth needs. Commissioners meet monthly, meet with their Councilmember, plan youth events and report to the Council.
who_can_apply: Youth appointed by the Mayor with City Council approval (10 voting seats). The page does not list ages or grades. A city factsheet in search results reportedly said ages 13 to 18, grades 7 to 12, but that is unconfirmed. The City tries to balance seats by school and council district.
duration: Meets 2nd Tuesday, Sept to May, 6:00 pm, Elk Grove Council Chambers
deadline_text: No open seats as of Oct 27, 2026. All 10 seats are filled. When a seat opens, the City posts a notice with an application.
how_to_apply: When a seat opens, use the Apply to the Youth Commission link (City Clerk vacancies page). Questions: youthcommission@elkgrove.gov or (916) 627-3254.
notes: Age and grade rules are not on the City page. Ask the City before you apply. One city sheet said ages 13 to 18 (grades 7 to 12), but that is not confirmed. The Mayor picks members, so seats are hard to get. Sign up for updates on the City page to hear when a seat opens. Read on the City page Oct 27, 2026: 10 members, and they meet on the 2nd Tuesday, September to May, at 6 pm.
